Migration assertions cover all declared fields, PostgreSQL types, defaults, tenant foreign key, exact denial-code allowlist, and no business-command uniqueness.

WP1.2-A and WP1.2-B both pass. No HTTP, app-role/RLS, inbox, WP1.3 retry, or independent closure claims are made.
